one_line_thesis: Normalized owner cash at $248.64 implies ~20% annual return; personal-lines compounder with peak-cycle earnings risk; hold on math, validate $30/sh normalization.

deep_dive.executive_summary: At about $251.72 per share, our base case implies 19.52% per year over seven years on normalized owner cash of $30.00 per share, above the ~15% threshold. Allstate is the third-largest U.S. personal P&C insurer with improving underwriting discipline, a scaled investment portfolio, and active capital return ($1.24 billion of buybacks in 2025, $1.06 billion of common dividends). industry.structure: U.S. personal auto and homeowners insurance is concentrated among a handful of national carriers (State Farm, Progressive, Allstate, GEICO) with high marketing intensity and state-by-state rate regulation.
industry.share_shift: Direct-channel insurers gained auto share in the 2010s; incumbents with multi-channel models (Allstate, Progressive) are reinvesting in pricing sophistication and expense cuts to defend share.
industry.trend: 2022-2024 loss inflation forced industry-wide rate increases; 2025-2026 focus shifts to profit retention, catastrophe reinsurance costs, and telematics-based underwriting (Arity).
